status.summary: Dated operator announcement explicitly describes current operation and GPU provision at the named Takamatsu facility. This is current-operation confirmation, not opening or expansion completion.

locator.precision: Approximate analyst-selected marker for the RIST Kagawa host property, rounded to four decimals. Highreso occupies part of the facility; this is not the DC room, occupied floor, building footprint, surveyed point or legal parcel boundary.
locator.uncertainty_reason: Imagery acquisition date and absolute geolocation accuracy are unestablished. Schematic-map alignment, roof parallax and manual matching introduce unquantified uncertainty; coordinate decimal places are not ground accuracy.
locator.identity_review: The property manager names Highreso Kagawa as a RIST tenant. Its labelled access map and exterior photo, the operator exterior photo and the historical DBJ interview identify the same host property, south of Sunshine Street opposite Sunmesse and west of the separate administration building. Root and an independent reviewer inspected the match. The marker does not assert that the DC occupies the entire host facility.

scoped_project_details.capacity_exclusion: Floor area, investment and historical GPU quantities are not IT load or current installed capacity.
scoped_project_details.address_caveat: The administrative address 2217-15 and RIST address 2217-43 are not used as coordinate sources; the named map/photo property match resolves the locator.

additions.distinctness_review: No Highreso, Takamatsu, GPUSOROBAN or RIST aliases match 410 sites, 435 projects or imported identity records. The nearest existing Atlas site is Kobe, approximately 105.6 km away. Genkai and Ayagawa are separate facilities. Nearest-point distance supports, but does not alone establish, distinctness.
additions.successor_review: September 24 explicitly confirms ongoing operation. The December 19, 2024 opening is separately historical; September connection has month precision only. No later closure or replacement was found in the bounded official-source review, and no physical status is inferred from image vintage or elapsed time.
